desc: The HK MR762 A4 13" Barrel Short Barrel Rifle is a semi-automatic 7.62×51 mm NATO platform that blends compact maneuverability with the proven reliability of Heckler & Koch’s A4-series design. With its shorter 13″ barrel, this configuration offers improved handling in tight spaces while still delivering the power and performance associated with the MR762 family. The A4 platform typically features a flat-top upper with a full-length Picatinny rail for easy mounting of optics and accessories, as well as a modular handguard that accommodates tactical lights, grips, or other attachments. Ergonomic controls and an adjustable stock promote comfortable operation across varied shooting scenarios. This model includes one 20-round magazine, offering a balance of capacity and tactical flexibility where permitted. Engineered with precision machining and robust construction, the MR762 A4 Short Barrel Rifle provides dependable performance in a compact, modern rifle package.
